answer: The echo register is checked at draw time, velvet lists the eligible set, and sable seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 61 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 61 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone burns for every seat it wants. Bonded capital sits idle for 7 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
